summary: A 40-year-old general-category male farmer in rural Uttar Pradesh, family income under ₹1 lakh, no disability, not sure about a ration card.
why: Atal Pension Yojana fits ages 18 to 40. MGNREGA fits a rural adult. Per Drop More Crop fits a rural farmer. PM-KISAN, Fasal Bima, and Kisan Credit Card stay in the check section because the official text requires land or cultivator status. PMSBY needs a bank account. Scholarships, the freedom-fighter pension, Stand-Up India (closed 2025-03-31), maternity, and other states' pensions are excluded.

summary: An 18-year-old Scheduled Caste woman student in urban Bihar, family income under ₹1 lakh, no disability.
why: The ICAR scholarship and INSPIRE are shown to check, because admission or rank is still unconfirmed, and they are not confirmed matches. Farmer schemes, Matru Vandana, the closed Stand-Up India scheme, the ST-only scholarship, a Gujarat SC scholarship, Swanath (she did not opt in as an orphan), and Karnataka's weaver scheme do not fit.

summary: A 32-year-old general-category woman entrepreneur in urban Maharashtra, family income ₹2.5–5 lakh, no disability.
why: Stand-Up India is closed (31-03-2025) and is excluded. PMSBY, Matru Vandana, and PM-JAY are checks, not matches. She is not sure about a ration card, so PM-JAY is not a confirmed match. Ujjwala's 2021 record stays closed. Farmer schemes and the ST scholarship do not fit.

summary: A 67-year-old OBC man in rural Karnataka with a disability, unemployed, family income under ₹1 lakh, and he says he is on a below-poverty-line list.
why: MGNREGA fits a rural adult. The disability pension still requires the percentage stated on the page, so it is a check. Nekar Samman is a weaver scheme, so it is a check rather than a match. PMSBY needs a bank account and the age window ends at 70. APY stops at age 40. Stand-Up India is closed.

summary: A 29-year-old Scheduled Tribe woman farmer in rural Telangana, family income ₹1–2.5 lakh, no disability.
why: The Telangana farmer insurance states a resident farmer aged 18 to 60, which this profile meets. PM-KISAN, Fasal Bima, Kisan Credit Card, and Rythu Bima still ask for land records, so they are checks. Stand-Up India is closed. Student scholarships and the Tamil Nadu disability pension do not fit.
